source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion: Use the incident records to complete the Incident Summary Report. 3. Complete as much of the Incident Report as possible using the information from the incident records. 4. Scan the incident records and upload them with the attached word document form into the incident management system (i-manager) under the “files” section. Note: Complete one form for each injured worker. All first aid and medical attention forms must now be scanned and attached to the incident report form in I MANAGER. Injury Report only to be completed for injuries only where an employee is off work due to the injury, not first aid cases. If you have any issues, please contact the Human Resources Department @507-332-6409. Important: 1st aid cases are to be completed and reviewed at the Supervisors 1st Aid meeting by that supervisor. Please insure that any recommendations or action steps are included so they are
